title: ZUBA Gets a New Look
summary: New 2D art across the site, ZUBA in divine royal attire, a rebuilt token page and the first ZUBA whitepaper.
achievements: Redrew ZUBA standing in divine African royal attire, plus fire guardian, explorer and griot looks
Redid every film and game in a clean 2D African animation style
Rebuilt the token page: supply, allocation, audit and KYC, utilities and where to trade
Published the ZUBA whitepaper as an in-game storybook
Added our partners and live listings: PancakeSwap, DEX Screener and BscScan
next: Share early concept work from the first game
body:
A legend needs a face the world remembers. This update gave ZUBA a new one.

We moved the whole site to a clean 2D animation style inspired by the best of African animation, and dressed ZUBA in the gold, white and violet of a guardian of stories.

The token page now tells the coin's story in five short chapters, and the whitepaper explains why we exist, what we are building and how $ZUBA fits into it. Read it, then tell us what you think in the village.

title: The Village Has a Home
summary: The official ZUBA website is live, with the Theatre, the Roadmap and this very notebook.
achievements: Opened the Theatre: 5 film concepts and 5 game concepts
Published the roadmap: five phases from Awakening to Africa to the World
Started this Developer Notebook so every holder can follow the build
next: Publish partner and listing updates as they go live
Share the first ZUBA character art in royal attire
body:
Every journey needs a camp. Today we set ours.

This notebook is where the builders of ZUBA report back to the village. No hype, no fog: what we shipped, what we learned and where we are heading next. Each entry is a marker on the map. Follow the trail and you will always know exactly where we stand.

> Ubuntu: I am because we are.

See you at the next marker.
